def increasing_run_plus_increase_count(xs):
    if not xs: return 0
    best = run = 1
    for i in range(1, len(xs)):
        if xs[i] > xs[i-1]: run += 1
        else: run = 1
        if run > best: best = run
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, len(xs)):
        if xs[i] > xs[i-1]: total += 1
    return best + total

def decreasing_run_plus_equal_count(xs):
    if not xs: return 0
    best = run = 1
    for i in range(1, len(xs)):
        if xs[i] < xs[i-1]: run += 1
        else: run = 1
        if run > best: best = run
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, len(xs)):
        if xs[i] == xs[i-1]: total += 1
    return best + total
